info.name: OCI Managed Services for Mac Mac Device API

description.content: Use the OCI Managed Services for Mac API to create and manage orders for dedicated, partially-managed Mac servers hosted in an OCI Data Center. To learn more about the service, see the [OCI Managed Services for Mac documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/managed-mac/home.htm).
